build.reason: The build route compiles fuzz_privkey against a parser declaration requiring seven arguments, while the complete entry supplies five.

input.reason: The entry passes bounded fuzz-supplied bytes and their size to the in-memory private-key parser; the recipe supplies key, PEM and DER seeds.

lifecycle.reason: The entry initializes the PK context before parsing, initializes and frees RSA export MPIs on successful RSA parses, and frees the PK context after normal parsing.

control_flow.reason: The failed parser call prevents any input from reaching the success guard, RSA export checks, EC curve check or final cleanup in a built target.

accepted.requirement: Build fuzz_privkey with a call matching the seven-argument mbedtls_pk_parse_key declaration, including an RNG callback and context.
accepted.target_route: The recipe builds programs/fuzz; fuzz_privkey includes pk.h and calls mbedtls_pk_parse_key after mbedtls_pk_init under MBEDTLS_PK_PARSE_C.
accepted.failure_condition: With the parser enabled in the supplied default build, the five-argument call is rejected during compilation, so no working fuzz_privkey artifact is produced.
accepted.alternative_paths: The complete entry has no other parser call. The recipe’s fallback make command compiles the same stale source and cannot repair its argument list.
